content: Vedant Thakur inquired about the next steps for his life insurance policy. Agent Anjali Desai confirmed that policy details were sent for review. Vedant asked for a clarification on the difference between term life and whole life insurance, which was explained by the agent. Vedant expressed a preference for term life insurance and requested instructions on how to proceed with the application.
